patch.role: Conditional recomputation that restores the strip only for numeric-looking cell groups.
lines: if all(s.strip().isdigit() for s in strings):

inputs.mask_numeric: center-aligned numeric cells padded with spaces
inputs.expose_alpha: center-aligned alphabetic cells padded with spaces
inputs.control_right_numeric: numeric cells but right-aligned (A's branch not taken)
inputs.control_no_space: center-aligned numeric cells with no surrounding whitespace

rationale: The conditional branch covers numeric centre-aligned columns only.  The masking witness is mask_numeric; expose_alpha satisfies AC5 because the compensation is not entered there.
